caption: The drawing features a single object: a sofa with an exaggerated, heart-shaped backrest and gently rounded arms. The sofa is upholstered in a uniform shade of deep pink or red fabric, with darker accents indicating tufted, buttoned details across the backrest and seat, giving a soft, cushioned appearance. The edges of the sofa, including the backrest, arms, and front base, are outlined with a decorative trim in a slightly lighter shade. The sofa stands on four short, conical legs depicted in a light brown or beige color. The object is centrally positioned within a plain, light-background rectangular frame, and the surrounding space is empty except for a faint, single-line border that encloses the entire drawing. There is a small text or signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll Sofa
